blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Human-object interaction (HOI) detection aims to localize human-object pairs and recognize their interactions. Traditional supervised methods perform strongly but rely on task-specific training. Recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs) offer a promising route to training-free HOI detection through their broad visual-semantic knowledge and versatile perceptual and reasoning capabilities. However, existing approaches largely invoke these capabilities through loosely coordinated inference stages. This fragmented execution restricts the role of interaction hypotheses in guiding visual exploration, leaving key participants overlooked and local ambiguities unresolved. Furthermore, propagating early semantic assumptions through subsequent visual grounding and relation prediction induces self-reinforcing semantic circularity. To resolve these challenges, we propose HarnessHOI, a training-free framework that transforms passive MLLM inference into an active interaction-centric harness. Specifically, we introduce an interaction-guided perception mechanism that projects emerging interaction hypotheses back into the visual space to discover missing participants and refine ambiguous evidence through targeted observation. Furthermore, a relation-agnostic geometric adjudication module reconciles multi-source evidence to establish a unified spatial basis for grounded interaction reasoning across multiple actions and semantic roles. Extensive experiments on HICO-DET and V-COCO demonstrate that HarnessHOI achieves state-of-the-art performance among training-free methods, confirming the effectiveness of the proposed harness for complex interaction understanding. Code will be released upon publication.
blocks.zh: 人-物体相互作用(HOI)检测旨在将人-物体对子定位并识别其相互作用. 传统监督方法运作有力,但依靠具体任务的培训。 最近的多模式大型语言模型通过其广泛的视觉语义知识和多功能的认知和推理能力,为无培训的HOI探测提供了一条很有希望的道路。 然而,现有办法主要通过松散协调的推断阶段来利用这些能力。 这种支离破碎的执行限制了互动假说在指导视觉探索中的作用,使得关键参与者被忽略了,地方上的模糊不清也得不到解决. 此外,通过随后的视觉地基和关系预测来传播早期语义假设,会诱发自我增强的语义循环. 为了应对这些挑战,我们提议HarnessHOI, 一个无培训框架,将被动的MLLM推论转化为积极的以互动为中心的工具。 具体地说,我们引入了一个互动指导感知机制,将新出现的互动假设投射回视觉空间,以发现缺失的参与者,并通过有针对性的观察来完善模棱两可的证据. 此外,一个关系不可知几何判断模块调和了多源证据,为跨多动作和语义角色的基于相互作用推理建立统一的空间基础. 有关HICO-DET和V-COCO的广泛实验表明,HarnessHOI在无培训方法中实现了最先进的性能,证实了为复杂互动理解而提议的利用的有效性. 守则将在出版后公布。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Human-object interaction (HOI) detection aims to localize human-object pairs and recognize the interactions between them, typically represented as ⟨ human , action , object ⟩ \langle\mathrm{human},\mathrm{action},\mathrm{object}\rangle triplets ( Chao et al., 2018 ; Gupta and Malik, 2015 ) . As a foundational task for scene understanding, it supports applications ranging from visual surveillance ( Dogariu et al., 2020 ; Li et al., 2024 ) to embodied AI ( Mascaro et al., 2023 ; Bahl et al., 2023 ) . Traditional supervised methods have achieved strong performance by learning task-specific interaction representations and prediction functions from HOI annotations ( Gkioxari et al., 2018 ; Liao et al., 2022 ) . However, their reliance on extensive annotations and dedicated training limits their scalability to the compositional and long-tailed interaction space encountered in real-world scenes ( Hou et al., 2020 ; Hou et al., 2021 ) .
blocks.zh: 人-对象相互作用(HOI)检测旨在将人-对象对定位并识别它们之间的相互作用,通常表现为: 人-,动作-,对象-\langle\mathrm{human},\mathrm{action},\mathrm{object}\rangle 三重体(Chao等,2018;Gupta和Malik,2015). 作为了解场景的基础任务,它支持各种应用,从视觉监视(Dogariu等,2020年;Li等,2024年)到体现AI(Mascaro等,2023年;Bahl等,2023年). 通过从HOI说明(Gkioxari等,2018;Liao等,2022)中学习特定任务的互动表现和预测功能,传统被监督的方法取得了强效. 然而,他们依赖广泛的说明和专门的训练,使其可伸缩性仅限于现实世界场景中遇到的构成和长尾的相互作用空间(Hou等,2020;Hou等,2021).

blocks.en: Recent vision-language models and multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have substantially expanded their ability to visual understanding and visual-semantic knowledge ( Radford et al., 2021 ; Bai et al., 2025 ) . Initial approaches integrate this knowledge into HOI detectors through feature alignment, prompt adaptation, or supervised optimization ( Lei et al., 2024b ; Lei et al., 2024a ) . Recent work further develops part-aware interaction representations ( Tonini et al., 2026 ) and unifies HOI detection with generation ( Yang et al., 2026 ) . Although effective, these approaches still require specific training, reintroducing the annotation and optimization burden that foundation models are expected to alleviate. Training-free paradigms therefore directly exploit frozen pretrained models for interaction grounding and prediction. Retrieval-based approaches score candidate interactions against visual-semantic knowledge ( Tonini et al., 2025 ) , while the variant formulates recognition as candidate-conditioned semantic assessment ( Xuan et al., 2026 ) . Recent agentic methods further revisit candidate interactions and recover visual entities through multi-stage semantic reasoning ( Lei et al., 2026 ) . Despite this progress, existing approaches leave semantic reasoning and visual perception through a separate process, leaving perception passive to the emerging interaction hypotheses.
blocks.zh: 近期的视觉语言模型和多模式大语言模型(MLLMs)大大地扩大了其视觉理解和视觉语义知识的能力(Radford等,2021;Bai等,2025.). 初步办法通过特征对接、迅速适应或监督优化,将这一知识纳入HOI探测器(Lei等人,2024b;Lei等人,2024a.)。 近期的工作进一步发展了部分意识互动表达(Tonini等,2026年)并统一了HOI检测与生成(Yang等,2026年). 这些办法虽然有效,但仍需要具体培训,重新提出基础模型可望减轻的注释和优化负担。 因此,无培训模式直接利用被冻结的预先培训的模式进行互动定位和预测。 基于检索的方法对候选人与视觉语义知识的相互作用进行评分(Tonini等,2025年),而该变体则将确认为候选条件语义评估(Xuan等,2026年). 近期的代理方法通过多相语义推理(Lei等,2026.)进一步重温候选相互作用并恢复视觉实体. 尽管取得了这一进展,但现有的方法通过一个单独的过程留下了语义推理和视觉感知,使感知被动到新兴的相互作用假设.

blocks.en: Human-object relations are fundamentally constrained by both relational semantics and fine-grained visual evidence distributed across the scene ( Wang et al., 2019 ; Wan et al., 2019 ; Zhang et al., 2023 ) .An emerging interaction hypothesis provides cues to recover overlooked participants or resolve local visual ambiguity. Conversely, grounded visual evidence provides necessary spatial constraints to verify candidate relations. Existing methods fail to regulate this reciprocal dependency, resulting in two coupled limitations. First, visual perception remains static when emerging interaction hypotheses are not systematically projected back into the image space to guide observation. This creates perceptual passivity , leaving missing entities and ambiguous regions unresolved. Second, directly propagating semantic proposals through visual grounding and subsequent relation evaluation induces semantic circularity , where initial semantic assumptions bias the visual interpretation and produce self-reinforcing predictions and spurious relational judgments. The central challenge is therefore to harness the complementary semantic and perceptual capabilities of MLLMs within a unified framework, enabling interaction hypotheses to actively guide visual exploration while grounding the resulting judgments in instance-level visual evidence.
blocks.zh: 人与物的关系从根本上受到分布于整个场景的亲和语义和细微的视觉证据的制约(王等,2019;万等,2019;张等,2023. 新出现的互动假说为恢复被忽略的参与者或解决局部视觉模糊提供了提示. 相反,有根据的视觉证据为核实候选人关系提供了必要的空间限制。 现有方法未能规范这种对等的依赖性,导致两个相互制约。 首先,当新出现的相互作用假说没有系统地投射回图像空间来指导观测时,视觉感知仍然静止. 这就造成观念被动,使缺失的实体和模棱两可的区域得不到解决。 第二,通过视觉地基和后续关系评价直接宣传语义建议,诱发语义循环. . . . . . . . . . 因此,中心挑战是在一个统一的框架内利用MLLMs的互补语义和知觉能力,使互动假设能够积极指导视觉探索,同时将由此产生的判断建立在实例一级的视觉证据上。

blocks.en: To address these limitations, we propose HarnessHOI , a training-free framework that transforms MLLM interpretation into an active interaction-centric harness paradigm(Figure 1 ). To overcome perceptual passivity, HarnessHOI incorporates interaction-guided perception that projects emerging hypotheses back into image space, actively discovering interaction participants and requesting targeted observations for ambiguous evidence. To mitigate semantic circularity, relation-agnostic geometric adjudication reconciles the resulting localization candidates under persistent instance identities, establishing a unified visual grounding according to participant evidence. Grounded interaction reasoning then assesses multiple actions and semantic roles using these shared groundings and the acquired visual evidence. Together, these mechanisms establish an interaction-centric harness that coordinates interaction-guided evidence acquisition with relation-agnostic visual grounding, enabling coherent and reliable training-free HOI prediction with frozen MLLMs.
blocks.zh: 为了克服这些局限性,我们提议HarnessHOI(无培训框架),将MLLM解释转变为积极的以互动为核心的利用范式(图一)。 为了克服认知被动,HarnessHOI吸收了互动引导的感知,即将新出现的假说投射回图像空间,积极发现互动参与者,并请求有针对性地观察模糊的证据. 为缓解语义循环,关系-不可知几何判断调和了由此产生的以持续实例身份进行本地化的考生,根据参与者证据建立了统一的视觉地平线. 然后利用这些共享的地基和获得的视觉证据来评估多个动作和语义角色. 这些机制共同建立了一个以互动为中心的工具,用于协调互动指导证据的获取与关系不可知的可视地定位,从而能够以冷冻的MLLM进行连贯而可靠的无培训HOI预测。

blocks.en: Our main contributions are summarized as follows: • We present HarnessHOI , a training-free framework that harnesses complementary perceptual and semantic capabilities of frozen MLLMs for HOI detection, moving beyond isolated semantic scoring or loosely coupled multi-stage reasoning. • We introduce interaction-guided perception, relation-agnostic geometric adjudication, and grounded interaction reasoning to connect hypothesis-driven visual exploration with shared participant groundings and evidence-grounded relation assessment, addressing perceptual passivity and semantic circularity. • Extensive experiments on HICO-DET and V-COCO demonstrate that HarnessHOI achieves state-of-the-art performance among training-free methods, validating the effectiveness of the proposed interaction-centric harness for human-object interaction detection.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要贡献概述如下: 我们提出HarnessHOI(无培训框架),利用被冻结的MLLMs的辅助知觉和语义能力进行HOI检测,超越孤立的语义分数或松散地结合的多阶段推理。 我们引入了互动引导感知,关系不可知几何判断,并基于互动推理,将假说驱动的视觉探索与共享的参与者地基和以证据为根据的关系评估联系起来,解决感知被动和语义循环问题. • 关于HICO-DET和V-COCO的广泛实验表明,HarnessHOI在无培训方法中取得了最先进的性能,验证了拟议的以互动为中心的人类物体相互作用探测手段的有效性。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Traditional Human-Object Interaction Detection
blocks.zh: 2.1 传统的人与物相互作用检测

blocks.en: Traditional human-object interaction (HOI) detection frameworks primarily rely on fully supervised paradigms, which are broadly grouped into two-stage pipelines and single-stage set-prediction architectures ( Zhang et al., 2021a ; Zhang et al., 2022b ) . Two-stage methods detect human and object proposals prior to classifying interaction predicates ( Gao et al., 2018 ; Li et al., 2019 ; Zhang et al., 2021b ; Zhang et al., 2022a ) . Conversely, single-stage transformer architectures utilize learnable queries to directly decode relation triplets from global visual contexts ( Kim et al., 2021 ; Zou et al., 2021 ; Chen et al., 2021 ; Tamura et al., 2021 ) . To improve generalization across unseen combinations, recent work incorporates pretrained vision-language representations by aligning visual features with text embeddings ( Yuan et al., 2022 ; Yuan et al., 2023 ; Ning et al., 2023 ; Mao et al., 2023 ) . Although these supervised methods achieve competitive performance on closed-world benchmarks, they remain inherently constrained by task-specific parameter optimization and heavy reliance on exhaustive triplet annotations, impeding their scalability to open-world scenarios.
blocks.zh: 传统的人与物相互作用(HOI)检测框架主要依靠完全监督的范式,这些范式大致分为两级管线和单级设置预测架构(Zhang等,2021a; 张等, 2022b.). 双相方法在将相互作用的上游分级之前检测出人和物体的建议(高等等,2018;李等,2019;张等,2021b;张等,2022a.). 反之,单相变压器架构利用可学习的查询,直接从全球视觉背景解码三相关系(Kim等,2021;Zou等. 2021; Chen等, 2021; Tamura等, 2021). 为改善对隐形组合的概括,最近的工作通过将视觉特征与文字嵌入相配合,纳入了经过预先培训的视觉语言表述(袁等,2022;袁等,2023;宁等,2023;毛等,2023). 虽然这些受监督的方法在封闭世界基准上取得了竞争业绩,但它们仍然受到特定任务参数优化和严重依赖详尽无遗的三重说明的固有制约,妨碍了其适应开放世界情景的能力。

blocks.en: 2.2 Foundation Models for HOI Detection
blocks.zh: 2.2 霍伊检测基础模型

blocks.en: The evolution of vision-language models and multimodal large language models offers expansive visual-semantic knowledge, prompting a shift toward parameter-efficient and training-free HOI detection. Early adaptation strategies align interaction representations with pretrained visual-semantic knowledge ( Wu et al., 2023 ; Cao et al., 2023 ; Lei et al., 2025a ) . Recent methods learn part-aware representations ( Tonini et al., 2026 ) , distill MLLM knowledge into HOI detectors ( Gao et al., 2025 ) , or unify detection and generation ( Yang et al., 2026 ) . Supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning further adapt MLLMs for interaction reasoning ( Wu et al., 2026b ) . Although effective, these approaches still require specific optimization. Training-free methods therefore directly exploit frozen foundation models for interaction prediction. Visual-semantic retrieval approaches calculate similarity scores between representations and text embeddings ( Tonini et al., 2025 ) . The variant formulates HOI detection as candidate-conditioned generation ( Xuan et al., 2026 ) . Recent agentic frameworks introduce multi-agent and multi-turn reasoning to propose and revisit candidate interactions prior to visual grounding ( Wang et al., 2026 ; Lei et al., 2026 ) . Despite these advancements, current training-free paradigms treat semantic reasoning and visual grounding as isolated steps. As a result, visual perception remains fundamentally passive to initial semantic hypotheses, leaving models susceptible to perceptual omission and semantic circularity.
blocks.zh: 视觉语言模型和多模式大型语言模型的演变提供了广泛的视觉语义知识,促使人们转向参数高效和无培训的HOI检测。 早期的适应战略使互动表述与事先受过训练的视觉语义知识相一致(Wu等,2023;Cao等,2023;Lei等,2025a)。 近期方法学习了部分知觉表达(Tonini等,2026年),将MLLM知识分馏入HOI检测器(Gao等,2025年),或统一检测和生成(Yang等,2026年). 监督的微调和强化学习进一步使MLLMs适应交互推理(Wu等,2026b.). 这些办法虽然有效,但仍需要具体优化。 因此,无培训方法直接利用被冻结的基础模型进行相互作用预测。 视觉语义检索方法计算出表示和文本嵌入之间的相似分数(Tonini等,2025.) . 该变体会将HOI检测形成候选条件生成(Xuan等,2026年). 近期的代理框架引入了多代理和多回合推理,在视觉定位前提出并重新审视候选人互动(Wang等,2026;Lei等,2026.). 尽管取得了这些进步,但目前的无培训范式将语义推理和视觉地基化视为孤立的步骤. 因此,视觉感知对于最初的语义假说仍然具有根本的被动性,使模型容易被知觉省略和语义循环.

blocks.en: 2.3 MLLM Harnessing for Visual Reasoning
blocks.zh: 2.3 MLLLM 语言学 利用视觉理由

blocks.en: Active perception principles advocate dynamically adapting visual observation based on task demands rather than relying on static image features Bajcsy (1988) . Recent vision-language research operationalizes active perception by incorporating selective region re-encoding or localized attention mechanisms during MLLM inference Zhang et al. (2025a) ; Shalam et al. (2026) . In parallel, agentic workflows decompose complex visual tasks into sequential reasoning and grounding operations Lei et al. (2026) . However, existing active harnessing strategies are primarily designed for free-form visual question answering or coarse region grounding, lacking effective and controllable mechanisms to manage complex relational understanding inherent to HOI detection. Applying generic workflows directly to HOI detection allows unconstrained semantic assumptions to distort visual search. HarnessHOI overcomes these limitations by unifying interaction-guided perception with relational reasoning, enabling a controlled harnessing paradigm that prevents semantic bias while maintaining rigorous spatial and relational grounding.
blocks.zh: 积极感知原则主张根据任务需求动态地调整视觉观察,而不是依赖静态图像特征Bajcsy (1988年). 近期的视觉语言研究通过在MLLM推论中将选择性区域再编码或局部关注机制(2025a)纳入其中,将活性感知付诸实施;Shalam等(2026). 同时,代理工作流程将复杂的视觉任务分解为相继的推理和地基操作Lei等 (2026). 然而,现有的主动利用战略主要是为了自由形式的视觉问题回答或粗糙的区域地面定位,缺乏有效和可控制的机制来管理HOI探测所固有的复杂关系理解. 将通用的工作流程直接应用到HOI检测中,可以使不受约束的语义假设扭曲视觉搜索. 节奏 HOI克服了这些限制,将互动引导感同关系推理相统一,使控制式的利用范式能够防止语义偏差,同时保持严格的空间和关系地平线.

blocks.en:
As illustrated in Figure 2 , HarnessHOI consists of
interaction-guided perception,
relation-agnostic geometric adjudication, and grounded interaction reasoning.
Specifically, we use the interaction hypotheses generated by F θ F_{\theta} to
guide participant discovery and targeted observation, associating the

instance identities. We then apply relation-agnostic geometric adjudication
to select a consistent grounding for each participant according to its
identity, category, and visible extent. Based on these shared groundings
and the acquired image evidence, grounded interaction reasoning evaluates
multiple actions and semantic roles through visual question answering.
The same frozen MLLM performs all three stages, with its answer
distributions determining geometric selection and interaction scores.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: We evaluate HarnessHOI on the complete HICO-DET ( Chao et al., 2018 ) and V-COCO ( Gupta and Malik, 2015 ) test sets, containing 9,658 and 4,946 images, respectively. HICO-DET reports Full, Rare, and Non-Rare mAP over 600 HOI categories under Default and Known Object evaluation. Open-vocabulary evaluation follows RF-UC, NF-UC, UO, and UV. V-COCO reports role AP over 25 semantic roles under scenarios S1 and S2. Both benchmarks require participant matching at IoU 0.5. Detailed metric definitions and evaluation protocols appear in Appendix B .
blocks.zh: 我们评价了完整的HICO-DET(Chao等,2018年)和V-COCO(Gupta和Malik,2015年)测试集,分别包含9,658和4,946个图像. HICO-DET在默认和已知对象评价下报告Full,Rare,和Non-Rare mAP超过600个HOI类别. 开放式投票评价遵循RF-UC、NF-UC、UO和UV。 V-CO报告在情景S1和S2下,AP的角色超过25个语义角色. 这两项基准要求参与者在IoU 0.5进行匹配。 详细的计量定义和评价规程见附录B。

blocks.en: All perceptual and reasoning operations use a single frozen Qwen3.5-9B ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) , with at most two local observations per image. The harness receives the image and public interaction vocabulary. Prompts and inference policy are selected using the official training sets, following the protocol in Appendix B . Inference settings, implementation, and visual questions appear in Appendices A , B.3 , and G .

blocks.en: 4.2 Comparison with State-of-the-Art Methods
blocks.zh: 4.2 与最新方法的比较

blocks.en: Table 1 compares HarnessHOI with representative task-optimized and training-free HOI detectors. HarnessHOI establishes state-of-the-art training-free performance on both benchmarks. On HICO-DET, it achieves 33.20% Default Full mAP, surpassing AgentHOI ( Lei et al., 2026 ) by 3.59 points and the training-free variant of DA-HOI ( Xuan et al., 2026 ) by 1.70 points, and reaches 36.85% under Known Object evaluation. It also obtains the best training-free Rare and Non-Rare results, with 41.63% Rare mAP exceeding AgentHOI by 1.30 points. The consistent gains across frequency groups and evaluation settings demonstrate the effectiveness of the HOI harness in recognizing common and infrequent interactions.
blocks.zh: 表1 对比 配有具有代表性的任务优化和无培训的HOI探测器. HarnessHOI在这两项基准上建立了最先进的无培训业绩。 在HICO-DET上,它实现了33.20%的默认全mAP,超过AgentHOI(Lei等,2026年)3.59分,而DA-HOI(Xuan等,2026年)的无训练变体则达到1.70分,在已知对象评价下达到36.85%. 它还获得了最佳的无训练"稀有"和"非稀有"成绩,稀有MAP比AgentHOI多出1分30分. 不同频率组和评价环境的一致收益表明,人道主义倡议在确认共同和不经常的互动方面是有效的。

blocks.en: On V-COCO, HarnessHOI obtains 44.65%/49.70% role AP under S1/S2, surpassing DYSCO ( Tonini et al., 2025 ) by 1.85/1.88 points. The gains under both scenarios demonstrate the effectiveness of the harness in recognizing actions and identifying their corresponding role targets. Extended results, including a common-evaluator comparison with the released predictions of AgentHOI, are provided in Appendix C .
blocks.zh: 在V-CO中,HarnessHOI在S1/S2下获得了44.65%/49.70%的角色AP,超过DYSCO(Tonini等,2025年)1.85/1.88分. 在这两种设想下取得的成果表明,这种利用在确认行动和确定其相应作用目标方面是有效的。 附录C提供了扩展结果,包括与AgentHOI发布预测进行的共同评价者比较。

blocks.en: Table 2 reports results under RF-UC, NF-UC, UO, and UV using the same HarnessHOI predictions. The method achieves 40.15%, 33.64%, 35.45%, and 33.87% Unseen mAP, respectively, attaining the best training-free results in all four partitions. Improvements over AgentHOI ( Lei et al., 2026 ) reach 1.75 points on UO and 4.02 points on UV. On NF-UC, HarnessHOI surpasses the strongest previous training-free result, ADA-CM ( Lei et al., 2023 ) , by 3.53 points. It also obtains the strongest reported training-free Seen results across all four settings. The simultaneous gains on Unseen and Seen classes demonstrate the effectiveness of the harness across interaction compositions, object categories, and actions. Complete results appear in Appendix C .

blocks.en: 4.3 Ablation Studies
blocks.zh: 4.3 阅读研究

The component studies use the same frozen Qwen3.5-9B and report HICO-DET Default Full mAP and V-COCO S1/S2 role AP on the complete test sets. Detailed settings and complete results are provided in Appendix D .

D: inclusion of discovered participants; O: targeted observation; G: geometric adjudication; V: visual relation verification. ✓ \checkmark denotes retained, × \times removed, and – not applied. HICO-DET reports Default Full mAP; V-COCO reports S1/S2 role AP (%). Best results are bold.

blocks.en: Table 3 compares the complete HOI harness with direct generation and an initial-instance baseline that verifies relations among initially localized participants. On HICO-DET, the initial-instance baseline achieves 31.45% mAP compared with 15.62% for direct generation, and the complete harness further reaches 33.20%. On V-COCO, the complete harness improves the initial-instance baseline from 42.90%/47.20% to 44.65%/49.70% AP. These results demonstrate that grounded verification strengthens interaction recognition, while interaction-guided perception and geometric adjudication further improve detection through participant discovery and shared grounding. Candidate-ranking analysis and backbone generalization with InternVL3-8B and Qwen2.5-VL-7B are presented in Appendices E.4 and D.6 .
blocks.zh: 表3将整个HOI牵引装置与直接生成和初步启动基线进行比较,以核实最初本地化参与者之间的关系。 在HICO-DET上,初始启动基线达到31.45%的mAP,而直接生成则达到15.62%,而完整的牵引力进一步达到33.20%. 在V-COCO方面,全管改进了初始启动基线,从42.90%/47.20%到44.65%/49.70%AP. 这些结果表明,基于核查可加强互动的识别,而互动指导感知和几何判断则通过参与者的发现和共享地基,进一步改善检测。 附录E.4和D.6列出了候选人等级分析和主干概况,包括InternVL3-8B和Quen2.5-VL-7B。

blocks.en: As shown in Table 3 , participant discovery improves V-COCO S2 AP by 0.77 points. Under the same generation budget, interaction-guided discovery outperforms repeated participant localization by 0.75 points in HICO-DET mAP and 0.78/0.82 points in V-COCO AP (Table 4 ). With region counts and sizes fixed, targeted observation improves over non-directed observation by 0.50 and 0.58/0.62 points, respectively. Interaction semantics therefore provide effective guidance for recovering overlooked participants and observing relevant regions. The coverage analysis in Appendix D.3 further shows how recovered participants contribute to interaction recognition.
blocks.zh: 如表3所显示的,参与者发现使V-COCO S2 AP改进了0.77分. 在同一生成预算下,相互作用导出发现的成绩在HICO-DET mAP中比重复参与者本地化多出0.75分,在V-COCO AP中比0.78/0.82分(表4). 随着区域计数和规模的固定,定向观测比非定向观测分别提高0.50分和0.58/0.62分. 因此,互动语义为恢复被忽略的参与者和观察相关区域提供了有效的指导。 附录D.3中的覆盖范围分析进一步显示恢复的参与者如何有助于互动识别。

blocks.en: Table 4 evaluates relation-agnostic geometric adjudication and grounded interaction reasoning. With candidate boxes and image views fixed, selecting shared groundings according to participant identity, category, and visible extent improves over relation-conditioned adjudication by 0.41 points in HICO-DET mAP and 0.47/0.54 points in V-COCO AP. On identical relation candidates, verification using the selected participants and acquired visual evidence further improves over proposal-conditioned questions by 0.70 and 0.73/0.86 points. Together, these results validate the separation between hypothesis-guided visual exploration and evidence-grounded interaction assessment.
blocks.zh: 表4评价关系不可知几何判断和有根据的互动推理. 随着候选框和图像视图的固定,根据参与者身份,类别和可见程度选择共享地基,比关系条件裁定在HICO-DET mAP中提高了0.41分,在V-COCO AP中提高了0.47/0.54分. 就同等关系候选人而言,利用选定的参与者和获得的可视证据进行核查,比提案规定的问题进一步提高了0.70分和0.73/0.86分。 这些结果加在一起验证了假说指导的视觉探索和有证据依据的互动评估之间的分离.

blocks.en: The analyses in Appendix D.5 show that combining perceptual associations with visual pair assessment improves detection, while verifying compatible labels recovers multiple actions involving the same participants. Role prediction further benefits from separately assessing action occurrence, target visibility, and role binding. On identical role candidates, compositional verification improves S1/S2 AP from 41.10%/46.30% to 44.65%/49.70%. With the final true-positive counts unchanged, this improvement reflects more accurate ranking of role predictions through the composition of action and target evidence.
blocks.zh: 附录D.5中的分析显示,将知觉相通与视觉配对评估相结合可以改善检测,同时验证相容的标签可以回收涉及相同参与者的多个动作. 角色预测进一步受益于对行动发生的单独评估、目标可见度和角色约束。 关于相同角色候选人,S1/S2 AP的构成核查从41.10%/46.30%改进为44.65%/49.70%。 由于最终真实正数不变,这一改进反映了通过动作和目标证据的构成对角色预测进行更准确的排序.

blocks.en: Table 33 compares detection performance and computational cost using the same frozen MLLM. Compared with direct generation using eight independent responses per image, HarnessHOI improves HICO-DET Full mAP by 13.36 points, while reducing the measured cost from 19.95 to 13.26 GPU-worker seconds per image. On V-COCO, the gains reach 22.44/23.20 points in S1/S2 AP, with measured costs of 22.07 and 20.94 GPU-worker seconds per image for HarnessHOI and repeated generation, respectively. The substantial detection gains at comparable computational cost demonstrate the advantage of coordinating visual exploration and grounded reasoning within the harness. Further computation analyses and hardware measurements are provided in Appendix E .

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We presented HarnessHOI, a training-free framework that harnesses frozen
MLLMs for active interaction-guided perceptual reasoning. Its HOI harness
connects interaction understanding with visual exploration, enabling the model
to discover overlooked participants and inspect ambiguous regions.
Relation-agnostic geometric adjudication reconciles the acquired localization
candidates, and grounded interaction reasoning uses the selected instance
groundings to verify multiple actions and semantic roles.
Extensive experiments on HICO-DET and V-COCO show that HarnessHOI achieves
state-of-the-art performance among training-free methods, demonstrating
the value of coordinating visual exploration and relation assessment
through shared instance groundings.

blocks.en: Ethics statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en: Our work adheres to the ICLR Code of Ethics. The research is conducted exclusively on publicly available, standard academic benchmarks (HICO-DET and V-COCO), which are widely used for evaluating human-object interaction detection algorithms. Our primary motivation is to advance the field for societal benefit, such as assistive robotics and accessible visual understanding. We believe that our framework supports the responsible development of AI by making the visual basis of interaction predictions available for inspection. Specifically, the harness associates discovered participants, targeted observations, and relation assessments with shared groundings, allowing predictions to be examined against the image evidence and corresponding visual questions. Responsible applications should respect privacy, consent, and the original data providers’ terms, while accounting for biases in pretrained models and benchmark coverage. Human oversight should be appropriate to the consequences of an incorrect prediction. We advocate for the responsible development and deployment of this technology, ensuring its application aligns with ethical principles and contributes positively to human well-being.
blocks.zh: 我们的工作遵守了《国际劳工和法学中心道德守则》。 研究完全以公开提供的标准学术基准(HICO-DET和V-COCO)进行,这些基准被广泛用于评价人与物体相互作用检测算法. 我们的主要动机是推进该领域,以造福社会,如辅助机器人和无障碍视觉理解。 我们认为,我们的框架通过提供互动预测的视觉基础供检查,支持负责任地发展AI. 具体地说,利用工具的同伙发现了参与者、有针对性的观察和与共同基础的关系评估,从而可以根据图像证据和相应的视觉问题来审查预测。 负责任的应用程序应当尊重隐私、同意和原始数据提供者的术语,同时考虑预先训练好的模型和基准覆盖范围的偏差。 人类监督应当适合错误预测的后果。 我们主张负责任地开发和应用这一技术,确保其应用符合道德原则并对人类福祉作出积极贡献。

blocks.en: A.1 Shared Participants and Interaction Evidence
blocks.zh: A.1 共同参与者和互动证据

blocks.en: Table 5 summarizes how the MLLM performs interaction-guided perception, relation-agnostic geometric adjudication, and grounded interaction reasoning. Throughout these stages, each participant retains a common identity that links its localization candidates to the interactions involving it.
blocks.zh: 表5总结了MLLM如何进行互动指导感知,关系不可知几何判断,以及基于互动的推理. 在整个这些阶段,每个参与者都保留一个共同的身份,将本地化候选人与参与互动联系起来。

blocks.en: Each entity e i e_{i} has a persistent identity and a candidate set ℬ i \mathcal{B}_{i} containing its alternative boxes, categories, and source views. blocks.en: Initial localization groups each person with the identifiable targets involved in their interactions. blocks.en: A hypothesis specifies the human, action, and target identities, together with semantic roles for V-COCO. Each person may participate in multiple actions with multiple targets. blocks.en: The harness executes at most two observation requests per image. Requests concerning an unlocalized target take precedence over requests to complete an existing participant’s boundary. blocks.en: We evaluate all 9,658 official test images over 600 human-object interaction classes, comprising 520 positive-interaction classes and 80 no_interaction classes. blocks.en: We use frozen Qwen3.5-9B for participant localization, interaction discovery, local observation, and grounded question answering. Its native visual encoder processes both the full image and local crops. Table 7 summarizes the inference settings.

blocks.en: D.3 Interaction-Guided Perception
blocks.zh: D.3 互动指导观念

blocks.en: Interaction-guided perception uses action and role hypotheses to discover relevant participants and select regions for closer observation. We first evaluate participant discovery and local observation, then compare them with repeated localization and non-directed observation to examine the contribution of interaction guidance.
blocks.zh: 互动引导感知使用动作和角色假设来发现相关参与者并选择区域进行更紧密的观察. 我们首先评价参与者的发现和局部观察,然后将它们与反复的局部化和非定向观察相比较,以审查相互作用指导的贡献.

blocks.en: The discovered-participant ablation excludes identities introduced by discovery and performs observation and relation assessment over the remaining participants. The observation ablation retains global discovery and its single localization per instance, omitting local observation and the corresponding geometric adjudication. These component configurations are reported in Table 3 , with full metrics in Tables 22 and 23 .
blocks.zh: 所发现的参与者的通融排除了由发现引入的身份,并对其余参与者进行了观察和关系评估。 观测衰减保留了全球发现及其每个实例的单一本地化,省略了局部观测和相应的几何判断. 表3中报告了这些构成部分的配置,表22和表23中有完整的衡量尺度。

blocks.en: The repeated-localization control receives the same full image, initial participant identities, and designated human groups as interaction-guided discovery. Its question directly requests additional visible participants associated with those humans. Both conditions use the same generation budget and the observation requests produced by interaction-guided discovery, followed by the same observation, geometric adjudication, and relation verification. Interaction-guided discovery improves detection on both benchmarks (Table 4 ), supporting the use of interaction semantics to direct participant search.
blocks.zh: 重复本地化控制接收到相同的完整图像,初始参与者身份,并指定了人类群体作为互动引导的发现. 它的问题直接要求更多与这些人类有关的明显参与者。 两种条件都使用相同的生成预算以及由相互作用引导的发现所产生的观测请求,然后是相同的观测、几何判断和关系核查。 互动引导的发现改进了对两个基准的检测(表4),支持使用互动语义来直接搜索参与者.

blocks.en: To evaluate region selection, the non-directed control retains the discovery output, target descriptions, observation count, and crop dimensions. Each crop center is sampled uniformly from valid image positions using a fixed seed. Both conditions use the same image processing and localization instructions, followed by geometric and relational assessment on their acquired observations. The gains from targeted observation in Table 4 demonstrate the value of selecting regions according to the interaction hypothesis.
blocks.zh: 为评价区域选择,非定向控制保留了发现输出,目标描述,观测计数和作物维度. 每个作物中心都使用固定种子从有效图像位置统一取样。 两个条件都使用相同的图像处理和本地化指示,然后对其获得的观测结果进行几何和关系评估. 从表4的定向观测中获得的收益表明根据相互作用假设选择区域的价值。

blocks.en: Figure 3: Interaction guidance and visual judgment. Each point reports the AP gain of the complete harness over the corresponding controlled alternative in Table 4 : repeated localization, non-directed observation, relation-conditioned adjudication, and proposal-conditioned verification. The three panels use the same scale.
blocks.zh: 图3:互动指导和视觉判断。 每个点都报告完全控制在表4中相应控制替代品上的AP收益:重复本地化、非定向观察、关系条件裁定和提案条件核查。 三个面板使用相同的比例.

blocks.en: We measure grounding coverage and relation-candidate coverage to evaluate participant acquisition at successive stages. Grounding coverage requires participant boxes that match an annotation at IoU 0.5, while candidate coverage additionally requires the corresponding action or role label. Each annotation is counted once.
blocks.zh: 我们衡量基本覆盖范围和关系范围,以评估在各阶段获得参与者的情况。 投地覆盖需要符合IoU 0.5注释的参与者盒,而候选覆盖还需要相应的动作或角色标签. 每注一分数.

blocks.en: Initial localization and discovery are evaluated on their respective participant sets. The all-localization condition uses the accumulated grounding candidates, and the selected-grounding condition uses one adjudicated candidate per identity. Physical interactions require matching human and target instances with distinct identities; HICO-DET also requires the target category to match. Missing roles require a matching person, together with the appropriate NULL prediction for candidate coverage.
blocks.zh: 初步本地化和发现在各自的参与者组中进行评价。 全地化条件使用累积的地基候选人,被选地基条件使用每个身份一个裁定的候选人. 物理互动需要匹配具有不同身份的人类和目标实例;HICO-DET还要求目标类别匹配. 缺少角色需要配对人员,同时对候选覆盖范围进行适当的NULL预测.

blocks.en: Table 25: Coverage of annotated interactions through participant construction and relation assessment. Grounding coverage requires matching participant boxes at IoU 0.5; the final candidate domain additionally requires the action or role label. V-COCO includes 3,969 missing-role annotations, for which participant grounding requires the person alone.
blocks.zh: 表25:通过参与者构建和关系评估来涵盖附加说明的互动。 入地覆盖需要匹配IoU 0.5的参与者框;最终候选域还需要动作或角色标签. V-COCO包括了3,969个缺失作用说明,对此,参与者的入地要求一个人单独出地.

blocks.en: As shown in Table 25 , discovery adds matching groundings for 571 HICO-DET interactions and 217 V-COCO roles. Local observation extends coverage by a further 12 and 23 annotations, respectively. The final selected groundings cover 22,895 HICO-DET interactions and 14,473 V-COCO roles, providing the participant pairs for subsequent verification.

blocks.en: We group the interaction annotations by participant and action structure. The multiple-human-box group contains images with at least two distinct annotated human boxes. The HICO-DET multiple-target group contains annotations whose action has at least two distinct physical targets within the image. For V-COCO, the corresponding multiple-target-state group treats each distinct physical target and NULL as target states, while reporting physical-role annotations. Small targets occupy at most 1% of the image area. The multiple-action group contains human-target pairs annotated with at least two actions, including NULL targets in V-COCO. Groups may overlap, and their sizes count annotations.
blocks.zh: 我们按参与者和行动结构划分互动说明。 该多人盒组包含至少两个有显著注释的图像. HICO-DET多目标组包含说明,其动作在图像中至少有两个不同的物理目标. 对于V-CO,相应的多目标状态组将每个不同的物理目标与NULL作为目标状态,同时报告物理作用说明. 小目标最多占据了图像区域的1%. 多动作组包含人-目标对并附加了至少两个动作,包括V-COCO中的NULL目标. 组合可能重叠,其大小计算为说明.

blocks.en: Missing-role annotations form a separate V-COCO group and contribute to the full totals. Their grounding and candidate coverage follow the person and NULL criteria above. The small-target group includes physical targets alone.

blocks.en: Table 26: Interaction coverage in the final action or role candidate domain. A ground-truth annotation is covered when at least one candidate has the required participant localization and interaction label. The initial-instance baseline verifies relations over the initially localized participants. Small targets occupy at most 1% of the image area. blocks.en: Table 27: Stage-wise coverage within complex-scene groups. Initial, Discovery, and Observed count annotations with matching participant geometry in the cumulative candidate sets; Selected uses adjudicated boxes; Relations additionally requires the correct action or role candidate. Counts use IoU 0.5 and overlapping annotation-defined groups.
blocks.zh: 表27: 复杂场景组的分阶段覆盖率。 初始,"发现",和"观察"的计数说明,与累积候选组合中的参与者几何相匹配; 选取使用裁定的框; 关系另外需要正确的动作或角色候选. 计数使用IoU 0.5和相重叠的注释定义的组.

blocks.en: The full harness covers 878 additional HICO-DET interactions and 925 additional V-COCO roles over the initial-instance baseline (Table 26 and Figure 4 ). These gains include 172 and 447 annotations with small targets, respectively, and 534 V-COCO roles involving multiple actions. Table 27 reports the corresponding stage-wise coverage. For V-COCO small targets, coverage increases from 3,407 after initial localization to 3,518 after discovery and 3,529 after observation, with 3,208 annotations represented in the final relation candidates.
blocks.zh: 整个利用范围包括另外878个HICO-DET相互作用和925个V-CO作用,超过了初始启动基线(表26和图4)。 这些成果包括分别包含小目标的172和447个说明,以及涉及多种行动的534个V-COCO角色. 表27报告了相应的分阶段覆盖情况。 对于V-COCO小目标,覆盖范围从初步本地化后的3,407个增加到了发现后3,518个和观察后3,529个,最终关系候选人中有3,208个说明.

blocks.en: The gains on small targets demonstrate the effectiveness of interaction-guided perception in recovering visually inconspicuous participants. Improvements on multiple-action pairs further show that the acquired groundings support several interactions involving the same entities.
blocks.zh: 在小目标上取得的成果表明,互动指导感知在恢复视觉不引人注目的参与者方面是有效的。 对多行动对子的改进进一步表明,获得的地基支持涉及同一实体的若干互动。

Coverage is normalized by the number of annotations in each group; the right column reports additional covered annotations. Groups can overlap. The underlying counts and group definitions appear in Table 26 .

blocks.en: D.4 Relation-Agnostic Geometric Adjudication
blocks.zh: D.4 关系不可知几何判断

blocks.en: We evaluate geometric adjudication by retaining discovery and observation and replacing visual selection with the first box associated with each identity (Table 3 ). This comparison examines the contribution of selecting a shared participant grounding from the acquired localization candidates.
blocks.zh: 我们通过保留发现和观察来评价几何判断,并用与每个身份相关的第一个盒子来取而代之(表3)。 这一比较审查了从已获得的本地化候选人中挑选共同参与人的贡献。

blocks.en: On HICO-DET and V-COCO, 479 and 424 identities adopt an observation-derived grounding, respectively. The selected grounding is shared across all relations involving the participant. The improvement over first-candidate geometry in Table 3 confirms the effectiveness of visual adjudication for interaction grounding.
blocks.zh: 在HICO-DET和V-COCO上,分别为479个和424个身份采用了由观测产生的地平线。 参与者参与的所有关系都有所选择的基础。 与表3中第一次扫描几何学相比的改进证实了视觉判断对相互作用的地基作用的有效性.

blocks.en: Relation-conditioned and relation-agnostic adjudication receive identical candidate boxes and image views for each instance. Relation-conditioned adjudication adds the earliest discovery or observation association involving that instance and asks which candidate best localizes the participant in that interaction. Relation-agnostic adjudication uses the identity, category, and visible extent criterion in Section 3.3 . Instances without a recorded association use the common identity-based criterion. Both conditions select one shared grounding per instance and apply the same subsequent relation verification.
blocks.zh: 对关系有条件和关系不可知性的裁决,每个案例都收到相同的候选框和图像视图。 以关系为条件的裁决增加了最早涉及该案例的发现或观察协会,并询问哪个候选人最能使参与该互动的参与者本地化。 关系不可知性判断使用第3.3节中的身份,类别和可见程度标准. 没有记录的关联案件采用基于共同身份的标准。 这两种条件都选择了每个实例的一个共同基础,并采用同样的后续关系核查。

blocks.en: With candidate boxes and image views fixed, relation-agnostic adjudication improves detection on both benchmarks (Table 4 ). The results support selecting shared groundings according to participant identity, category, and visible extent, independently of the proposed relation.
blocks.zh: 随着候选框和图像视图的固定,关系不可知性裁定可以改善对两个基准的检测(表4)。 成果支持根据参与者的身份、类别和可见程度选择共同基础,而不受拟议关系的影响。

blocks.en: D.5 Grounded Interaction Reasoning
blocks.zh: D.5 有根据的互动

blocks.en: We examine grounded interaction reasoning through complementary pair selection, multi-label verification, and compositional semantic-role assessment. These comparisons evaluate which participant pairs and relations are considered and how their visual evidence determines the final predictions.
blocks.zh: 我们通过互补的对子选择、多标签核查和组成语义-作用评估,来审查基础互动推理。 这些比较评价了哪些参与者对子和关系被考虑,以及他们的视觉证据如何决定最终的预测.

blocks.en: The proposal-conditioned control appends the original discovery proposals associated with the queried participants to the final action, agent, role-state, and binding questions. The harness condition uses the selected participants, public relation definitions, and image evidence. Pair retention, candidate relations, boxes, views, answer labels, and score composition are identical. Both conditions assess the full candidate domain, including relations absent from the discovery proposals. Grounded verification improves detection over proposal-conditioned questions on these identical candidates (Table 4 ), demonstrating the benefit of assessing relations directly from the acquired visual evidence.
blocks.zh: 附有条件的提案控制将与被询问的参与者有关的原始发现建议附入最终行动、代理人、作用状态和具有约束力的问题。 控制条件使用选定的参与者、公共关系定义和图像证据。 平分保留,候选关系,方框,视图,答题标签,分数构成相同. 这两个条件都评估了全部候选领域,包括发现建议中没有的关系. 基础核查有助于发现对这些相同候选人的有提案条件的问题(表4),表明直接从获得的视觉证据中评估关系的好处。

Each configuration retains the original relation scores on its selected pairs, together with HICO-DET no-interaction and V-COCO agent and NULL predictions. Combining the two sources achieves the best results on both benchmarks, improving HICO-DET mAP by 5.11 points over discovery and observation associations and V-COCO AP by 1.42/1.93 points over visual pair assessment. blocks.en: The final candidates cover 22,232 HICO-DET interactions and 13,628 V-COCO roles, retaining 97.1% and 94.2% of the annotations covered by the selected groundings. Positive-action and role-binding verification uses 39,791 of 416,280 human-entity pairs on HICO-DET and 17,804 of 251,376 on V-COCO. Thus, pair selection reduces the respective domains by 90.4% and 92.9% while retaining high coverage of the grounded interactions.
blocks.zh: 最终候选者包括22 232名HICO-DET互动和13 628名V-COCO角色,保留了选定基座覆盖的说明的97.1%和94.2%。 积极行动和作用约束核查在HICO-DET上使用39,791对416,280个人类实体,在V-CO上使用17,804对251,376个实体。 因此,配对选择将各自领域减少90.4%和92.9%,同时保持了对有底互动的高覆盖率。

blocks.en: Coverage measures the existence of matching candidates. Detection evaluation additionally assigns each prediction to its best-matching annotation and removes duplicates in score order. A prediction overlapping several annotations contributes at most one true positive, so final matching counts can differ from candidate coverage. The ranking bounds in Appendix E.4 follow the evaluator’s assignment rule.
blocks.zh: 覆盖面衡量是否有匹配的候选人。 检测评价额外将每个预测分配给其最匹配的注释,并按分数顺序去除重复. 一个预测与几个说明重叠,最多只能产生一个真实的正数,因此最终匹配计数可能与候选的覆盖不同. 附录E.4中的排名范围遵循评价员的派任规则。

blocks.en: As shown in Table 28 (b), label expansion increases HICO-DET mAP from 18.35% to 29.85% and V-COCO AP from 36.43%/39.81% to 42.27%/47.14%. The gains demonstrate the importance of verifying multiple compatible relations over shared participants, extending prediction beyond the labels proposed during discovery.

blocks.en: We compare compositional verification with a joint action-and-role question on identical participants, geometry, and role candidates. Each physical-target joint question uses the same full-image and crop inputs as its corresponding binding question; each NULL joint question uses those of its corresponding role-state question. The joint question evaluates action occurrence together with the target’s role; its NULL formulation evaluates action occurrence together with the absence of a visible role target. True-label support directly scores each candidate, with agent predictions unchanged.
blocks.zh: 我们把结构核查与关于相同参与者、几何和角色候选人的联合行动和作用问题进行比较。 每个物理-目标联合问题使用与其相应的约束性问题相同的全图像和作物投入;每个NULL联合问题使用其相应的角色-状态问题. 联合问题与目标的作用一起评价行动发生;其NULL配方与没有明显的作用目标一起评价行动发生. True-label支持直接给每个候选人打分,代理预测不变.

blocks.en: Compositional verification improves V-COCO S1/S2 AP from 41.10%/46.30% to 44.65%/49.70% (Table 28 (c)), with gains on 15 of 25 roles in S1 and 20 of 25 in S2. The final true-positive counts remain unchanged, showing that the improvement comes from more accurate ranking of role predictions. Image-paired bootstrap with 1,000 resamples gives 95% percentile intervals of [3.02, 4.10] and [2.85, 3.96] points for the S1 and S2 gains.

Compositional verification improves both roles of hit and the instrument role of cut under S1 and S2, with a 26.29-point gain for eat/instr under S1. The gains demonstrate the effectiveness of combining shared action evidence with the visibility and binding evidence of each role target.

blocks.en: For the joint and compositional role comparison, we draw 1,000 paired bootstrap samples of the test images with replacement ( Efron, 1979 ) , using seed 20260920. Each sample contains the original number of images and assigns identical image multiplicities to both methods’ predictions and annotations. We recompute AP under the original matching rules and class denominator, assigning zero to classes absent from a sample. The 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles of the paired AP differences form the confidence interval for each scenario.
blocks.zh: 为了进行联合和组成角色比较,我们用替换方式绘制出1000对试验图像的靴子样本(Efron,1979年),使用20260920. 每个样本包含图像的原始数量,并为两种方法的预测和说明分配相同的图像多功能. 我们根据原始匹配规则和分母重新计算AP,将零分配到样本中缺失的类. 相配的AP差异的2.5和97.5百分位数构成了每种情景的置信间隔.

blocks.en: Explicit missing-role assessment represents actions whose targets are not visible in the image. Removing NULL predictions reduces S1 AP from 44.65% to 39.20%, while the complete method obtains 49.70% under S2 (Table 23 ). blocks.en: Hardware cost is measured independently as amortized GPU-worker time, computed by summing the recorded processing time across GPU workers and dividing by the number of images. The measurement includes input preparation, model inference, and result collection, with all recorded inference work counted once; model loading and evaluation are excluded. On HICO-DET and V-COCO, the measured costs are 13.26 and 22.07 GPU-worker seconds per image, respectively.
blocks.zh: 硬件成本作为分期摊还的GPU-工人时间独立计量,计算方法是将记录的处理时间从GPU工人中相接并除以图像数量. 测量包括输入准备、模型推论和结果收集,所有记录的推论工作都计算一次;模型加载和评价不包括在内。 在HICO-DET和V-COCO上,测量到的成本分别为每幅图像13.26和22.07GPU-worker秒.

blocks.en: Hardware measurements use frozen Qwen3.5-9B in BF16 on NVIDIA A6000 GPUs, with one model replica per GPU, four active images per replica, and up to 32 concurrent requests per GPU. The harness measurement uses four GPUs. Continuous batching schedules generation and scoring requests, while shared visual representations and prefix caching reuse the common image and prompt context. The cache hit rates in Table 31 measure the fraction of scoring input tokens served from the prefix cache.
blocks.zh: 硬件测量在NVIDIA A6000 GPU上使用被冻结的BF16中Quen3.5-9B,每个GPU有一个模型复制,每个复制四个活性图像,每个GPU最多有32个并行请求. 牵引力测量使用四个GPU. 连续分批调度生成和打分请求,同时共享视觉表达和前缀的活化重用常见图像和快上下文. 表31中的缓存命中率测量了从前缀缓存中提供的分数输入符的分数.

The V-COCO joint action-and-role control evaluates new questions with the view assignment specified in Appendix D.5 . Perceptual ablations use the participants and views produced by each configuration. Shared computations are counted once when measuring a complete inference configuration.
blocks.zh: 对等,标签,和因子分解使用同一种关系支持来评价替代候选人集和分数组成. V-COCO联合行动和作用控制以附录D.5中规定的观点评价新问题。 概念活化利用了参与者和每个组合产生的观点. 共享计算在测量完整的推论配置时被计算一次.

blocks.en: E.3 Allocating Inference Computation
blocks.zh: E.3 分配推论计算

blocks.en: We compare the harness with repeated direct generation to examine how coordinated perception and reasoning affect detection performance and computational cost. Both methods use the same frozen backbone, full-image processing, sampling settings, and initial output budget. Repeated generation independently predicts participants and relations in each response, whereas the harness uses interaction hypotheses to acquire visual evidence for grounded verification.
blocks.zh: 我们把利用与重复的直接生成进行比较,以审查协调的认知和推理如何影响检测的性能和计算成本。 这两种方法都使用同一种被冻结的骨干,全图像处理,采样设置,以及初始产出预算. 反复生成会独立预测每个响应中的参与者和关系,而利用交互假说获取视觉证据进行有根据的验证.

blocks.en: We combine the first K ∈ { 1 , 2 , 4 , 8 } K\in\{1,2,4,8\} responses in a predetermined order using two fusion rules. Exact-match fusion retains the maximum score among predictions with identical categories, roles, target states, and boxes. Pair-IoU suppression removes lower-scored duplicates at threshold 0.5 within the same category, role, and target state. The hardware cost at each K K sums the recorded GPU-worker processing time of the constituent generation runs per image. Tables 33 and 34 report both rules on the same response sets.
blocks.zh: 我们用两种核聚变规则,将第一个K {{ 1, 2, 4, 8}的K\in\ 1, 2, 4, 8}按预定顺序反应。 精确匹配的聚变保留了相同类别、角色、目标状态和盒子的预测的最大分数。 Pair-IoU 压制在同一类别、作用和目标状态下,在0.5分值下消除分数较低的重复。 每个 K K 的硬件成本总和为组成元代记录的GPU-工作人处理时间运行每个图像. 表33和34都报告同一答复集的规则。

Cost is amortized GPU-worker time per image; values are reported in Tables 33 and 34 .

blocks.en: Figure 6 presents detection performance alongside hardware cost. With pair-IoU suppression, increasing the number of responses from one to eight raises HICO-DET mAP from 15.61% to 19.84% and V-COCO AP from 16.38%/21.18% to 22.21%/26.50%. The measured eight-response costs are 19.95 and 20.94 GPU-worker seconds per image, respectively. HarnessHOI achieves 33.20% and 44.65%/49.70%, with measured costs of 13.26 and 22.07 seconds per image. The gains over repeated generation demonstrate the effectiveness of coordinating visual exploration and relation verification within the harness.
blocks.zh: 图6显示检测性能和硬件成本。 随着对双IoU的抑制,反应数量从1个增加到8个,HICO-DET mAP从15.61%增加到19.84%,V-COCO AP从16.38%21.18%增加到22.21%26.50%。 测量到的8-应答成本分别为每幅图像19.95和20.94GPU-worker秒. HarnessHOI实现33.20%和44.65%/49.70%,测量成本为每幅图像13.26和22.07秒. 重复代代相传的成果表明,在利用资源范围内协调视觉探索和关系核查是有效的。

blocks.en: Repeated sampling produces additional interaction candidates and overlapping detections with slightly different boxes. Exact-match fusion retains these duplicates, and AP decreases as more responses are combined. Pair-IoU suppression improves AP by removing overlapping detections from the same responses. The following analysis evaluates candidate quality through the best AP attainable by reordering the predicted boxes and labels.
blocks.zh: 重复采样产生额外的相互作用候选物,并用稍有相差的盒子进行重叠检测. 精确匹配的聚变保留了这些重复,而AP随着更多的响应被合并而减少. Pair-IoU抑制通过从同一种反应中去除相重叠的检测来改进AP. 以下分析通过重新排列预测的盒子和标签,通过最佳的AP可实现性评价候选质量.

blocks.en: E.4 Fixed-Candidate Ranking Analysis
blocks.zh: E.4 固定候选人排名分析

blocks.en: We evaluate the quality of the generated candidates by fixing their boxes and labels and using ground-truth annotations to determine the optimal ranking.
blocks.zh: 我们评估所产生候选人的质量,方法是确定他们的盒子和标签,并利用地面真实说明来确定最佳排名。

blocks.en: Table 35 compares the harness with ground-truth-assisted ranking of a single direct-generation response. The resulting ranking upper bounds are 21.58% HICO-DET mAP and 30.69%/35.01% V-COCO AP. HarnessHOI exceeds these bounds by 11.62 and 13.96/14.69 points, respectively, demonstrating that its advantage extends beyond confidence estimation to the participants and relations available for prediction.
blocks.zh: 表35对单一直接生成反应的利用情况与地面事实辅助排名进行了比较。 由此产生的排名上限为21.58%的HICO-DET mAP和30.69%/35.01%的V-COCO AP. HarnessHOI分别比这些界限多出11.62分和13.96/14.69分,表明其优势超越了对参与者的信心估计和可供预测的关系.

blocks.en: Table 35: Ground-truth-assisted ranking of fixed direct-generation predictions. GT ranking retains the generated boxes and labels and optimally orders the candidates using annotations. HICO-DET reports Default Full mAP; V-COCO reports S1/S2 role AP (%).

HarnessHOI exceeds these bounds with its predicted scores by 2.70 and 2.75/3.30 points, respectively, and also exceeds the pair-IoU bounds of 30.09% and 41.40%/45.90%. The advantage persists even when the repeated-generation predictions are ranked optimally, demonstrating the importance of interaction-guided participant discovery and relation construction for HOI detection.
blocks.zh: 有8个答复,精确匹配的聚变达到30.50%的HICO-DET mAP和41.90%/46.40%的V-COCO AP的上限. HarnessHOI分别以2.70分和2.75/3.30分的预想分数超越了这些界限,也超过了对等-IoU分数的30.09%和41.40%/45.90%. 即使对重复生成的预测进行最佳排序,但这一优势依然存在,表明互动引导参与者发现和关系构建对于HOI检测的重要性.

Ground-truth matching identifies one correct prediction per covered annotation and ranks these predictions before false positives. Boxes, labels, and candidate counts remain unchanged, and HICO-DET averages over all 600 classes.

The two actions are then verified independently using the same person-book groundings. Table 39 reports the localization overlaps and relation scores.

blocks.en: In HICO-DET image 00001195 , the sitting hypotheses of two people direct observation to a shared crop containing the supporting bench. Observation recovers the bench, and both sitting relations use its selected grounding. One person-bench pair is retained through the observation association and the other through visual pair assessment, illustrating their complementary contributions to relation coverage.
blocks.zh: 在HICO-DET图像0001195中,两个人的坐着假说直接观测到一个包含支撑板凳的共享作物. 观察恢复了长凳,两个坐着的关系都使用它选定的地基. 通过观察协会保留一对人-地对一对,通过视觉对一评估保留另一对,说明他们对关系覆盖的补充贡献。

The MLLM assesses this question over { false , true , unknown }. Normalizing the first-token logits by Equation 2 gives a holding score of 0.9859. A separate reading question over the same participants gives 0.9796 (Table 39 ). Independent action assessments therefore retain both interactions on the shared groundings. Table 41 presents the corresponding factor composition for V-COCO roles.

blocks.en: F.2 Pair Retention in a Distant Gaze Relation
blocks.zh: F.2 隔离盖兹关系中的公平保留

blocks.en: V-COCO image 2473 contains an annotated gaze relation between two people. The observer and target boxes match their annotations at IoU 0.9560 and 0.9517. Although the agent and role-state questions favor looking and a visible target, the pair question assigns its highest support to false (Table 40 ). Neither discovery nor observation associates this pair. Equation 4 therefore excludes it from the binding domain, and no physical look/obj prediction is produced for that pair.

blocks.en: F.3 Shared Geometry and Distinct Semantic Roles
blocks.zh: F.3 共有几何和独特的语义作用

blocks.en: In V-COCO image 579060 , initial localization identifies the person, racket, and ball. The racket is both a held object and the instrument of hitting, while the ball fulfills the object role of hitting. The two hitting roles share action evidence, with separate visibility and binding questions identifying their respective targets (Table 41 ).
blocks.zh: 在V-COCO图像579060中,初始本地化识别出人物,叫声和球. 球拍既是被持有的物体,也是打球的乐器,而球则能完成打球的物体角色. 这两项打击作用共享行动证据,分别有能见度和具有约束力的问题确定各自的目标(表41)。

blocks.en: V-COCO image 468608 similarly distinguishes a knife as the cutting instrument and a cake as the object being cut. Both are available from initial localization, and their role predictions combine shared action evidence with target-specific assessments. The knife also participates in holding, illustrating the use of one grounding across different action-role assignments.
blocks.zh: V-COCO图像468608同样区分出刀为切割器,蛋糕为被切割器. 两者均可从初始本地化中获取,其作用预测将共享行动证据与特定目标评估相结合. 这把刀还参与持有,说明在不同的行动作用任务中使用了一种打地法。

The racket and knife fulfill instrument roles, whereas the ball and cake fulfill object roles. Each action contributes a shared agent support, combined with role-specific visibility and binding supports. Holding and the instrument role can share the same target grounding.

blocks.en: We provide the prompt instructions used for perception and relation verification. Each prompt incorporates the relevant participants, image views, and public interaction definitions.

blocks.en: G.1 Participant Localization
blocks.zh: G.1 参与者本地化

blocks.en: Initial localization receives the full image and public object vocabulary and returns categories, boxes normalized to [ 0 , 1000 ] [0,1000] , and appearance references: Localize the people and identifiable targets involved in the scene’s interactions. Organize the output by interaction group: list one person and all associated targets immediately after that person, then proceed to the next person. Cover holding, using, riding, sitting or leaning, wearing, carrying, caring, and person-to-person interactions. Include identifiable nearby objects that may support no-interaction assessment, while prioritizing interaction participants over unrelated background objects. Give one box for each complete visible instance and include each instance once. A person’s box should cover the visible person; an object’s box should cover the object itself. Describe each reference through visible appearance and position. Return the instance category, normalized box, and reference in the requested format.
blocks.zh: 初始本地化接收完整的图像和公共对象词汇和返回类别,框规范为 [0, 1000] [0, 1000], 外观参考: 将参与现场互动的人和可识别的目标定位。 按交互组组织输出:列出一人和所有紧接此人后的相关目标,然后继续到下一个人. 盖相接相接,用相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相 包含可识别的相邻对象,这些对象可能支持不互动评估,同时将互动参与者优先放在无关的背景对象上. 每个完整的可见实例给出一个框并包含每个实例一次. 一个人的盒子应覆盖可见的人;物体的盒子应覆盖物体本身。 通过可见外观和位置描述每个参考。 返回实例类别、规范框和所请求格式的引用。

blocks.en: G.2 Interaction Discovery and Observation Planning
blocks.zh: G.2 互动发现和观测规划

blocks.en: Discovery receives the full image, initial entities, designated human group, and public interaction definitions. The prompt requests hypotheses, additional participants, and observation regions: Inspect every designated human. Give concise visible evidence and identify the interactions involving that person. A person can perform several actions and interact with several targets. Use existing instance identities when their targets are already localized. Add an omitted, visually identifiable participant with its category, full-image box, and appearance reference. For role-based actions, distinguish the target fulfilling each object or instrument role. Examine held, worn, ridden, supporting, and distant visible targets. When the target cannot yet be localized reliably, retain its description and formulate a question for closer observation. Propose up to two regions, giving priority to unlocalized targets and then incomplete instance boundaries. Each request identifies the human, possible action and role, known target when available, target description, localization question, image region, and priority. The region should support localization of the complete visible instance. When the existing view resolves participant localization, return no observation request.
blocks.zh: 发现获得完整的图像,初始实体,被指定的人类群体,以及公共互动定义. 迅速要求假设、增加参与者和观测区域: 检查每一个指定的人。 提供简明可见的证据,并查明涉及该人的相互作用。 一个人可以执行几个动作,并与几个目标互动. 在目标已经本地化时使用已有实例身份 。 添加一个省略的、可视化的参与者及其类别、全图像框和外观参考。 对于基于角色的行动,要区分实现每个目标或工具角色的目标. 检查、穿戴、穿戴、支持和遥远的可见目标。 当目标还不能可靠地定位时,保留其描述,并提出一个问题供更密切地观察. 最多提出两个区域,优先考虑未确定地点的目标,然后是不完整的例子界限。 每项请求都确定了人、可能的行动和作用、已知的目标(如果有的话)、目标描述、本地化问题、图像区域和优先顺序。 该区域应支持将完全可见的实例本地化。 现有视图解决参与者本地化后,不返回观测请求.

blocks.en: G.3 Targeted Observation
blocks.zh: G.3 有针对性地观察

blocks.en: Observation receives a crop, the target description, and the local instances eligible for refinement. Output coordinates are normalized within the crop: Use this crop and target description to localize the relevant participants. Identify changes to the eligible instances and any additional visible participants. For an existing instance, retain its identity and report the changed category or box. Instances crossing the crop boundary provide context; update complete-instance boxes for eligible identities whose extents lie within the view. Describe newly identified participants with complete visible-instance boxes and categories. Preserve the distinction between a person and the object they hold or use. Localize visible extent without extrapolating occluded boundaries. Return instance updates and new participants. If the observation provides no reliable localization change, return empty changes.
blocks.zh: 观测得到一种作物、目标描述以及符合改进条件的地方实例。 输出坐标在作物内正常化: 利用这种作物和目标描述使相关参与者本地化。 查明符合条件的事例和任何其他可见的参与者。 对于已有的例子,保留其身份并报告已更改的类别或框。 跨越作物边界的事例提供上下文;更新完整的方框,以显示在视野内的合格身份。 说明新查明的参与者有完整的可见框和类别。 保留一个人与其持有或使用的物体之间的区别。 将可见范围本地化,而不外推被占用的边界. 返回实例更新和新参与者 。 如果观察没有提供可靠的本地化变化,则返回空变化.

blocks.en: Returned boxes are mapped to the full image by Equation 9 .
blocks.zh: 返回的盒子由方程式9绘制成完整的图像。

blocks.en: G.4 Geometric Adjudication
blocks.zh: G.4 几何判断

blocks.en: The geometry question receives the candidate category-and-box descriptions, full image, and acquired crops. Each candidate is assigned an answer letter: Compare the candidate descriptions of this instance against the image evidence. Select the candidate that best matches its identity, category, and complete visible boundary. For a person, assess the full visible person rather than a hand or torso. For an object, assess the extent of that object rather than its contact region with another participant. Judge localization correspondence; the candidate order does not indicate quality. Answer with the letter of the selected candidate.
blocks.zh: 几何题接收候选类别和框描述,完整图像,并获得农作物. 每个候选人都得到一封答复信: 将这个案例的候选描述与图像证据进行比较. 选择最适合其身份、类别和完整可见边界的候选对象。 对于一个人,评估整个可见人物而不是手或躯干. 对于一个物体,评估该物体的范围,而不是它与另一个参加者的联系区域。 法官的本地化通信;候选人命令没有显示质量。 以所选候选人之信作答.

blocks.en: G.5 Grounded Relation Questions
blocks.zh: G.5 有根据的关系问题

blocks.en: Relation questions receive the selected participants, action or role definition, and corresponding image views. They share the following instruction: Assess the specified instances from the image evidence. Use the given boxes to identify the person and target, and verify that those instances correspond to the visual question. Distinguish this person’s action from another person’s action and this target from another instance of its category. An interaction requires visual evidence beyond proximity or the object’s typical use. Multiple actions can hold for the same participants. Apply the supplied action and role meanings and answer with one word from the designated answer set.
blocks.zh: 关系问题接收选定的参与者,动作或角色定义,以及相应的图像视图. 他们同意以下指示: 从图像证据中评估指定实例 。 使用给定的框来识别人物和目标,并核实这些情况是否与视觉问题相符. 将此人的行为与他人的行为区分开来,将目标与另一类行为区分开来。 交互需要超越相近的视觉证据或对象的典型用途. 多个行动可以对同样的参与者进行。 应用提供的动作和角色含义,并用指定答案集中的一个单词回答.

blocks.en: Table 42 lists the question types and answer sets.
blocks.zh: 表42列出了问答类型。

blocks.en: Table 42: Semantic decisions in grounded question answering. Answer supports are obtained from first-token logits normalized within the designated set.
blocks.zh: 表42:在回答问题时的语义决定。 答题支持是从指定集内正常化的第一对数得到的。

blocks.en: The pair question asks whether any legal positive interaction is visually supported. Its answers denote support for at least one relation ( true ), rejection of all such relations ( false ), or unresolved evidence ( unknown ). Pair retention follows Equation 4 , combining this assessment with discovery and observation associations.
blocks.zh: 配对问题询问任何法律上的积极互动是否得到视觉支持. 它的答案表示至少支持一种关系(真),拒绝所有这种关系(假),或未解决的证据(未知). 第4等式之后保留对等,将这一评估与发现和观察协会结合起来。

blocks.en: No-interaction assessment verifies the participants’ identity and geometry together with the absence of legal positive interactions. Each positive-action question evaluates a specific predicate under its supplied definition: for example, hold concerns bodily or manual support of the target, and read concerns engagement with its textual content. Each question produces a separate false/true/unknown distribution.
blocks.zh: 无互动评估核实参与者的身份和几何特征,以及缺乏法律上的积极互动。 每个积极行动问题都根据其提供的定义评价一个具体的上游:例如,认为涉及对目标的身体或人工支持,并读取对其文字内容的参与。 每个问题都产生单独的虚假/真实/未知分布。

blocks.en: Conditional on the action, visible denotes a localizable role target in the image, including one absent from the entity set; missing denotes the absence of such a target; and unknown denotes unresolved visibility. Binding assesses whether the specified instance fulfills the object or instrument role.
blocks.zh: 对动作的附加条件,可见表示图像中一个可定位的角色目标,包括一个不在实体集中的角色目标;缺失表示没有这样的目标;未知表示未解决的能见度. 约束性评估指定实例是否满足对象或工具的作用。

blocks.en: G.6 Public Role Definitions
blocks.zh: G.6 公共作用定义

blocks.en: Table 42 gives the complete target meanings used in V-COCO questions. The role keys follow the benchmark representation. In particular, point/instr denotes the target indicated by the pointing gesture. Action definitions complement these role meanings by specifying the person’s activity: holding a phone and talking on a phone are assessed separately; standing on a board does not alone establish riding or jumping; and skiing, snowboarding, skateboarding, and surfing retain their distinct activity meanings. HICO-DET questions follow the public verb-object taxonomy, with definitions distinguishing predicates such as cut and cut_with , sit_at and sit_on , and hold and carry .
